# Pakete laden

```{r}
#| label: load-phyloseq
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

```

```{r}
#| label: Define path

base_path <- "C:/Users/user/Documents/Master_EnvironmentalSciences/Master_Thesis"

ps <- readRDS(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/phyloseq_all.rds"))
ps

meta_df_clean <- data.frame(sample_data(ps)) %>% rownames_to_column("sample")


# Qualitätskontrolle
cat("Proben:", nsamples(ps), "\n")
cat("ASVs:  ", ntaxa(ps), "\n")
summary(sample_sums(ps))
table(tax_table(ps)[, "Kingdom"])

# Nur Fungi behalten
ps_fungi <- subset_taxa(ps, Kingdom == "k__Fungi")
cat("\nFungi ASVs:", ntaxa(ps_fungi), "von", ntaxa(ps), "\n")
```

# Reads per Sample

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: Prune Phyloseq

# 1. Reads pro Sample anschauen – gibt es sehr wenige?
sort(sample_sums(ps))

# 2. Proben mit zu wenig Reads entfernen (z.B. < 1000)
ps <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps) >= 1000, ps)
cat("Proben nach Filterung:", nsamples(ps), "\n")

# 3. Überblick pro Käferart
sample_data(ps) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::count(beetle_species)
```
# Prepare data for ggplot

```{r}
#| label: Prepare data for Plots

sample_data(ps)$family <- dplyr::case_when(
  sample_data(ps)$beetle_species == "Pterostichus_aethiops" ~ "Carabidae",
  sample_data(ps)$beetle_species %in% c("Anthaxia_fulgurans",
                                         "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",
                                         "Chrysobothris_affinis",
                                         "Buprestis_haemorrhoidalis") ~ "Buprestidae",
  sample_data(ps)$beetle_species == "Bolitophagus_reticulatus" ~ "Tenebrionidae",
  sample_data(ps)$beetle_species %in% c("Rhagium_bifasciatum",
                                         "Rhagium_inquisitor",
                                         "Rhagium_mordax",
                                         "Rutpela_maculata",
                                         "Stenurella_melanura",
                                         "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis",
                                         "Grammoptera_ruficornis") ~ "Cerambycidae",
  sample_data(ps)$beetle_species == "Ips_typographus" ~ "Curculionidae"
)

# Prüfen
#View(sample_data(ps))
table(sample_data(ps)$family)

# Speichern
saveRDS(ps, file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/phyloseq_all.rds"))
```
# Grammoptera entfernen

```{r}
#Lt Jörn Buse waren diese Käfer zu lange in einer Tüte, sieht man bei NMDS dass sie nicht clustern, evtl. Kontamination

ps <- subset_samples(ps, beetle_species != "Grammoptera_ruficornis")
ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 0, ps)

cat("Proben nach Entfernung:", nsamples(ps), "\n")  # sollte 76 sein
cat("ASVs nach Entfernung:", ntaxa(ps), "\n")

# Speichern
saveRDS(ps, file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/phyloseq_all.rds"))
```
## Results: Read tracking

```{r}
metadata <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "Data/Metadata/metadata_all.csv"))
metadata %>% filter(beetle_species == "Grammoptera_ruficornis")

# ── Read-Tracking einlesen ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
runs <- c("EC24_245", "3XX", "Popa", "Buse")

track_all <- lapply(runs, function(run) {
  df <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output", 
                            run, "read_tracking.csv"))
  df$run <- run
  df
}) %>% bind_rows()


# Alle Samples pro Lauf
table(track_all$run)

# Nur Negativkontrollen
track_all %>%
  filter(grepl("NC|negativ|332|333|334", X)) %>%
  dplyr::count(run)

# Nur echte Proben (ohne NCs)
track_all %>%
  filter(!grepl("NC|negativ|332|333|334", X)) %>%
  dplyr::count(run)

# ── Zusammenfassung pro Lauf ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
grammoptera_ids <- c("EC24_245_0016_FITS_B04_iA", "EC24_245_0017_FITS_B05_iA",
                     "EC24_245_0018_FITS_B06_iA", "EC24_245_0019_FITS_B07_iA",
                     "EC24_245_0020_FITS_B08_iA", "EC24_245_0021_FITS_B09_iA",
                     "EC24_245_0022_FITS_B10_iA", "EC24_245_0023_FITS_B11_iA")

track_summary <- track_all %>%
  filter(!grepl("NC|negativ|332|333|334", X)) %>%
  filter(!gsub("-", "_", gsub("ns2024-18-", "", 
               gsub("_S\\d+_L001$", "", X))) %in% grammoptera_ids) %>%
  group_by(run) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples      = n(),
    reads_input    = sum(Input),
    reads_filtered = sum(Gefiltert),
    reads_merged   = sum(Merged),
    reads_nochim   = sum(Ohne_Chimaeren),
    pct_retained   = round(reads_nochim / reads_input * 100, 1)
  )

print(track_summary)

# ── ASVs pro Lauf ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
asv_counts <- data.frame(
  run   = c("EC24_245", "3XX", "Popa", "Buse", "Total"),
  ASVs  = c(1696, 1867, 248, 7307, 10970)
)

print(asv_counts)
```
## Results: Taxonomic Composition

```{r}
# Taxonomie-Übersicht
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))

# Klassifizierungsrate pro Ebene
for (rank in c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")) {
  n <- sum(!is.na(tax_df[[rank]]) & tax_df[[rank]] != "")
  cat(sprintf("%-10s %4d / %d  (%.1f%%)\n",
              rank, n, nrow(tax_df), 100 * n / nrow(tax_df)))
}

# Dominant Phyla
tax_df %>%
  mutate(Phylum_clean = gsub("p__", "", Phylum)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Phylum_clean)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Phylum_clean, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(10)

# Dominant Genera
tax_df %>%
  mutate(Genus_clean = gsub("g__", "", Genus)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genus_clean)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Genus_clean, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(10)
```
## Results: Plots

```{r}
# ── Plot 1: Phylum-Level Barplot ──────────────────────────────────────────────
phylum_df <- tax_df %>%
  mutate(Phylum_clean = gsub("p__", "", Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(Phylum_clean = ifelse(is.na(Phylum_clean) | 
                               grepl("Incertae_sedis", Phylum_clean),
                               "Unclassified/Incertae sedis", Phylum_clean)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Phylum_clean, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
         Phylum_clean = fct_reorder(Phylum_clean, n))

ggplot(phylum_df, aes(x = n, y = Phylum_clean, fill = Phylum_clean)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Ascomycota"                  = "#D94801",
    "Basidiomycota"               = "#2171B5",
    "Unclassified/Incertae sedis" = "#969696",
    "Mortierellomycota"           = "#74C476",
    "Mucoromycota"                = "#A1D99B",
    "Chytridiomycota"             = "#FDD0A2",
    "Rozellomycota"               = "#FDAE6B",
    "Basidiobolomycota"           = "#C7E9C0",
    "Olpidiomycota"               = "#BCBDDC",
    "Sanchytriomycota"            = "#DADAEB"
  )) +
  labs(x = "Number of ASVs", y = NULL,
       title = "") +
  xlim(0, max(phylum_df$n) * 1.15) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Caption: Fungal diversity at phylum level

ggsave(file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/phylum_barplot.pdf"),
       width = 9, height = 5)
```

```{r}
# ── Plot 2: Top 15 Genera ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
genus_df <- tax_df %>%
  mutate(Genus_clean = gsub("g__", "", Genus)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genus_clean) & 
                !grepl("Incertae_sedis", Genus_clean)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Genus_clean, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  mutate(Genus_clean = fct_reorder(Genus_clean, n))

ggplot(genus_df, aes(x = n, y = Genus_clean)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2171B5") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "Number of ASVs", y = NULL,
       title = "") +
  xlim(0, max(genus_df$n) * 1.15) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))


# Caption: Top 15 most frequent fungal genera

ggsave(file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/genus_barplot.pdf"),
       width = 9, height = 6)

# Plot 1 und 2 zusammenfügen

plot_phylum <- ggplot(phylum_df, aes(x = n, y = Phylum_clean, fill = Phylum_clean)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Ascomycota"                  = "darkgoldenrod2",
    "Basidiomycota"               = "chocolate3",
    "Unclassified/Incertae sedis" = "#969696",
    "Mortierellomycota"           = "#74C476",
    "Mucoromycota"                = "#A1D99B",
    "Chytridiomycota"             = "#FDD0A2",
    "Rozellomycota"               = "#FDAE6B",
    "Basidiobolomycota"           = "#C7E9C0",
    "Olpidiomycota"               = "#BCBDDC",
    "Sanchytriomycota"            = "#DADAEB"
  )) +
  labs(x = "Number of ASVs", y = NULL) +
  xlim(0, max(phylum_df$n) * 1.15) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot_genus <- ggplot(genus_df, aes(x = n, y = Genus_clean)) +
  geom_col(fill = "bisque3") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  labs(x = "Number of ASVs", y = NULL) +
  xlim(0, max(genus_df$n) * 1.15) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))

combined_tax <- plot_phylum + plot_genus +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.4, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

combined_tax

ggsave(file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/taxonomy_combined.pdf"),
       plot = combined_tax, width = 14, height = 6, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# Wie viele sind wirklich unclassified?
# Wie viele haben kein Phylum?
sum(is.na(tax_df$Phylum) | tax_df$Phylum == "")

# Wie viele sind Incertae sedis?
sum(grepl("Incertae_sedis", tax_df$Phylum), na.rm = TRUE)

# Gesamt unklassifiziert auf Phylum-Ebene
sum(is.na(tax_df$Phylum) | tax_df$Phylum == "" | 
    grepl("Incertae_sedis", tax_df$Phylum), na.rm = TRUE)
```
